title: Search orders by customer email
body:
Support keeps asking engineering to look up a customer's orders by email. This adds `GET /api/orders/search?q=<part of an email>&status=<status>&limit=<n>` for shop staff.

- Results are scoped to the signed-in shop and capped at 200.
- `status` is checked against the statuses we actually store.
- The match is case-insensitive (`ILIKE`), so `Jane@` finds `jane@example.com`.
